description: Build templates 41-50: Testimonials, business services, real estate, education, travel. Each must have distinct professional layouts.
steps: Create templates/client-testimonials/ - Testimonial/social proof with quote marks, avatar area, star rating
Create templates/customer-feedback/ - Review card with customer photo, rating bar, and quote block
Create templates/pricing-table-packages/ - Service pricing tiers with 3-column comparison layout
Create templates/real-estate-house/ - Property listing with large photo area, specs grid, and agent info
Create templates/house-sale/ - Property sale with SOLD/FOR SALE badge, price, and feature list
Create templates/business-webinar/ - Webinar registration with speaker photo, topic, date/time, and CTA
Create templates/now-hiring/ - Recruitment ad with job title, requirements list, and apply CTA
Create templates/back-to-school/ - Education campaign with playful elements and school supplies theme
Create templates/tropical-beach-tourism/ - Travel destination with full-bleed beach imagery and overlay text
Create templates/travel-tourism/ - Travel package campaign with destination grid and price/dates
Each template MUST include: manifest.json, layout-1x1.html, assets/, thumb.png, BUILD-NOTES.md
Professional/service templates should feel trustworthy; travel templates should feel aspirational
acceptance_criteria: 50 total template directories exist under templates/
No JavaScript in any HTML file
All CSS uses only semantic variables
All text nodes have data-role and data-importance
findings: All 10 templates (41-50) built successfully. STATUS.json updated to 50 completed. Each has manifest.json, layout-1x1.html, assets/ dir, thumb.png, BUILD-NOTES.md. No JavaScript in any file. All text nodes have data-role and data-importance. All media slots have data-slot. pricing-table-packages has no media slots by design (pure text/data layout). house-sale has data-visibility for SOLD/FOR SALE badge toggle.
